name: Corrosive Blood
body:
School transmutation; Level bard 3, sorcerer/wizard 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a flask of acid worth 10 gp)

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 min./level (D)

DESCRIPTION

Corrosive blood turns your blood into a powerful dissolving agent. This does not cause you any harm, but if a slashing or piercing weapon deals damage to you, a small amount of this potent acidic blood sprays forth, dealing 1d6 points of acid damage +1 point/2 levels (maximum +10) to the weapon in question. If a slashing or piercing natural weapon injures you, the acid affects the creature directly. Either way, the weapon or the creature may reduce the damage by half with a successful Reflex save.
